figurative_meaning_en: to slip away from one's grasp
example_sentences_in_bangla: ব্যবসাটা ভালো চলছিল, কিন্তু হাত ফসকে চলে গেল।
example_sentences_in_english: That opportunity slipped through my fingers.
The business was going well, but it slipped away from my grasp.
note: This idiom metaphorically describes losing something valuable due to carelessness or misfortune.
